content: प्रतिबद्ध {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Bound, tied, fastened to; वनाय पीतप्रतिबद्धवत्सां यशोधनो धेनुमृषेर्मुमोच <ls>R. 2. 1</ls>. .²2 Connected with, harmonizing with; रसान्तरेषु प्रतिबद्धरागम् <ls>Ku. 7. 91</ls>. .²3 Hindered, obstructed, impeded. .²4 Set, inlaid; यस्याः पुरा परिचयप्रतिबद्धबीजम् <ls>Māl. 10. 21</ls>. .²5 Furnished with, possessing. .²6 Entangled, involved. .²7 Kept at a distance. .²8 Disappointed. .²9 Fixed, directed. .²10 Attached or hanging to. .²11 Excluded, cut off. .²12 (In <ab>phil.</ab>) Invariably and inseparably connected and implied (as fire in smoke). .²13 Wreathed (as a garland); सखि एकपार्श्वविषमप्रतिबद्धा खल्वेषा रचना <ls>Māl. 2</ls>.
